episodes.title: Le journal du matin, dimanche 25 octobre
episodes.headline_en: The anti-terrorist prosecutor announced on Sunday morning that the custody of the suspect in Friday's attack at Trappes and La Verrière is suspended for a psychiatric observation of up to 48 hours
summary_en: The anti-terrorist prosecutor announced on Sunday morning that the custody of the suspect in Friday's attack at Trappes and La Verrière is suspended for a psychiatric observation of up to 48 hours
Serbia votes today in legislative elections, after a student protest movement against the power of Aleksandar Vucic
Ouest-France writes that Friday's attack at Trappes and La Verrière left one dead and five injured

episodes.headline_en: Football: the New Orleans Saints face the Pittsburgh Steelers at the Stade de France on Sunday 25 October, at 2.30pm according to L'Equipe
summary_en: Football: the New Orleans Saints face the Pittsburgh Steelers at the Stade de France on Sunday 25 October, at 2.30pm according to L'Equipe
